# GitHub Copilot Instructions

This repository is a Django/Python project using Ninja. 

## Instruction Files

multiple instruction files can be found under `.github/instructions/`:

### General Instructions:
- **File:** [general.instructions.md](.github/instructions/general.instructions.md)
- **Scope:** Project-wide architecture and coding guidelines
- **Applies to:** All development work
### Python/Django Code Style:
- **File:** [python.instructions.md](.github/instructions/python.instructions.md)
- **Scope:** Python-specific coding standards and best practices
- **Applies to:** `**/*.py` files
